proposal.summary: FortiAnalyzer versions 7.2.0–7.2.1, 7.0.0–7.0.4 and 6.4.0–6.4.10 may allow a remote authenticated attacker to read the client machine password in plain text in a heartbeat response when a log-fetch request is made from the FortiAnalyzer.
proposal.affected_product: FortiAnalyzer versions 7.2.0 through 7.2.1, 7.0.0 through 7.0.4 and 6.4.0 through 6.4.10

proposal.recommended_next_step: Validate the issue on an affected FortiAnalyzer test instance and determine whether a vendor fix or mitigation is available; if confirmed, coordinate disclosure and provide remediation guidance.
